issue.symptom: ForLoop showed First/Last = 0/0 (expected 0/3); ForLoop.Index and ForEach.'Array Element' had no outgoing wire, so the downstream Print String printed its default ('Hello') instead of the loop value.
issue.ue_message: no compile error; visual/structural mismatch reported from UE editor screenshots

root_cause.direct: BP_04 builder only wired exec for the loop bodies and never created the data edge loop-value -> PrintString.InString; and SetPinDefault used spaced names ('First Index'/'Last Index') that do not equal the macro's internal pin names ('FirstIndex'/'LastIndex').
root_cause.generator_layer: FindPin matched pin names exactly (case-insensitive only), so display-vs-internal spacing differences silently failed; there was no checked data-connection helper, and builders relied on a non-existent assumption that exec wiring alone would surface values.
root_cause.ir_layer: expected_ir declared the intent (First=0,Last=3, Print(index)/Print(element)) but omitted the data edges and the engine-inserted autocast nodes, so it diverged from real generated structure.
root_cause.version_compatibility: Macro pin names are inconsistent even within UE 5.4 (ForLoop 'FirstIndex' no space vs ForEach 'Array Element' with space); the normalized FindPin fallback also tolerates 5.x drift.

affected_patterns.pattern: Value output not wired to typed consumer; convertible types need an autocast node
Pin lookup/default by display name fails on spaced internal names

fix.strategy: Generalize at the helper layer: (1) FindPin gains a normalized (space/underscore-insensitive) fallback pass so all lookups/defaults tolerate display-vs-internal names; (2) new FBPGen::ConnectData wires data pins by name and relies on UEdGraphSchema_K2::TryCreateConnection -> CreateAutomaticConversionNodeAndConnections to auto-insert the int->string conversion node (the same behaviour the editor performs on a drag), then verifies both endpoints linked. Builders BP_02/04/11 now wire loop value -> Print via ConnectData.

validation.viz_rerun: success (Graphviz PNG/SVG); mermaid .mmd source updated (mmdc not installed)
ue_manual_check_required: BP_04: confirm For Loop iterates 0..3 and Print prints the index via the inserted 'To String (Integer)' node
BP_04: confirm For Each Loop element feeds Print via its 'To String (Integer)' node
BP_02 / BP_11: confirm ForEach element printed via autocast

next_user_action: Open BP_04_ExecFlow_Control in UE and verify the two loop->print autocast paths and First/Last = 0/3
Spot-check BP_02 and BP_11 ForEach element prints
